decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed vehicular crossover would be acceptable because of its position and design, as it is unlikely to lead to conditions prejudicial to highway and pedestrian safety and therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), T.4.4 (Road Safety) and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby approved is implemented, a front garden fence or wall shall be erected to a height no more than 1 metre.  It shall include an opening of no more than 2.4metres width.
description: Construction of a vehicle means of access to the highway.
